sql:
SELECT s.District 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(f.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(f.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT dname, AVG(AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY dname
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District, AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = REPLACE(ss.cds, '0', '')
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT dname
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode AND satscores.sname = schools.School
WHERE schools.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY dname
ORDER BY AVG(AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.District Name
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY frpm.District Name
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.District Name
FROM frpm
JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE frpm.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY frpm.District Name
ORDER BY AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(sa.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(sa.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(f.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.District Name, AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ON schools.School = satscores.sname
WHERE frpm.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY frpm.District Name
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT frpm.District Name, AVG(satscores.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
JOIN satscores ON schools.School = satscores.sname
WHERE frpm.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY frpm.District Name
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.District Name
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
JOIN schools sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY f.District Name
ORDER BY AVG(s.AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.District 
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.District
ORDER BY AVG(f.FRPM Count (K-12)) DESC
LIMIT 1;
